questions.q: What was the boy trying to make the pony do?
questions.evidence: we saw a boy trying to leap a pony over a gate

questions.q: What did the pony finally do after the boy kept whipping and kicking him?
choices: Threw the boy into a thorn hedge and galloped home
questions.evidence: sent the boy neatly over into a broad quickset hedge

questions.q: Why did John refuse to help the boy out of the hedge?
choices: He thought a little scratching would teach the boy a lesson
He was in too much of a hurry
He did not see the boy
He was afraid of the pony
questions.evidence: maybe a little scratching will teach you not to leap a pony over a gate

questions.q: Why did John decide to ride home by Farmer Bushby's?
choices: He thought the boy might lie, so he wanted to tell what really happened
He wanted to rest Black Beauty
questions.evidence: that young fellow is a liar as well as a cruel one

questions.q: How did Farmer Bushby react when John told him what Bill had done?
choices: He said Bill needed a lesson and he would stop it
He said the pony should be sold
questions.evidence: Bill wants a lesson about this, and I must see that he gets it

questions.q: What cruel thing did James catch Bill doing at school?
questions.evidence: catching flies and pulling off their wings

questions.q: James said Bill would "swagger about" at school. What does swagger mean?
choices: Walk and act in a proud, showing-off way
questions.evidence: he used to swagger about and bully the little boys

questions.q: What did the schoolmaster say was "the devil's own trade-mark"?
questions.evidence: cruelty was the devil's own trade-mark
